title: Harmonizing longitudinal research data with armonia
text: Real-world longitudinal studies collect data across multiple waves, often different teams, questionnaire versions, even languages. result collection data frames equivalent often aren’t: column names differ (v010 vs V010), factor labels different languages (Good vs Bueno), accumulate small typos time. armonia handles four phases: Dictionary: scan waves generate Excel reference table match variables assign factor levels. Standardize: apply dictionary rename variables recode factor levels integers. Assemble: stack waves (long format) join (wide format longitudinal analysis). relabel factors using dictionary. Anonymize data: replace raw IDs salted hashes. vignette walks phase using fictional WellBeing Study: ten participants measured two waves, second wave administered Spanish.

title: Harmonizing longitudinal research data with armonia
text: full workflow condensed single annotated script, mapping directly onto four-phase diagram package documentation.
code: library(armonia)  # ── 1. RAW DATA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── wave1 <- data.frame(...)   # English wave wave2 <- data.frame(...)   # Spanish wave  # ── 2. DICTIONARY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── dict_path <- "my_study_dictionary.xlsx"  dict_init(list(w1 = wave1, w2 = wave2), save_path = dict_path) # Open dictionary.xlsx in Excel: #     Variable_Map_Wide : set meaningful target_name for each row #     Factor_Levels     : align standard_code across waves, add standard_label  dict_validate(dict_path)  # ── 3. STANDARDIZE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── std_w1 <- dict_apply(wave1, wb_path = dict_path, source_name = "orig_w1") std_w2 <- dict_apply(wave2, wb_path = dict_path, source_name = "orig_w2")  # Pre-bind gate: confirm class consistency across waves check_bind_ready(list(w1 = std_w1, w2 = std_w2)) # Review any warnings before proceeding  stacked <- harm_bind_waves(list(w1 = std_w1, w2 = std_w2))  # Post-bind data quality gate: verify no information was lost in transformation check_data_loss(data_list = list(w1 = wave1, w2 = wave2),                 master    = stacked,                 wb_path   = dict_path) # Review any warnings before proceeding  # For modelling: stacked (integer-coded factors) # For reporting: assign_standard_labels() restores readable labels stacked_labeled <- assign_standard_labels(stacked, dict = dict_path)  # ── 4. ASSEMBLE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── check_integrity(stacked, id_col = "id", time_col = "source_wave")  # Audit IDs for typos before the longitudinal join check_id_audit(id_col1 = std_w1$id, id_col2 = std_w2$id, wb_path = dict_path) # Review Review_IDs sheet; correct any confirmed typos  std_w1$id   <- anon_clean_email(std_w1$id)   # fix typos in wave-1 IDs  longitudinal <- harm_add_timepoint(   master_data = std_w1,   new_data    = std_w2,   by_id       = "id",   suffix      = "_w2" )  # ── 5. ANONYMIZE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Sys.setenv(HARMONIZE_SALT = "your-project-secret-salt")  # set once per session  longitudinal$pseudo_id <- anon_hash(anon_clean_email(longitudinal$id)) longitudinal$id        <- NULL

title: Flag structurally suspicious email addresses — check_email

title: Initialize a data dictionary — dict_init

title: Initialize a data dictionary — dict_init
text: data_list Named list data frames, one per wave data version. match_by Character string. Strategy aligning variables across waves. "position" (default) matches column index, suitable waves share structure differ language. "name" matches alphabetically variable name, suitable column order trusted. type_prefix Character string. Prefix prepended auto-generated target_name values (e.g. "var" produces var_001, var_002, ...). save_path Character string. File path output .xlsx dictionary. Defaults "dictionary.xlsx". max_unique overrides maximum number unique values detect_factor_potential(). Defaults NULL (thus applies heuristic rules). See detect_factor_potential() details.

title: armonia 1.0.0
text: Initial release. Dictionary workflow: dict_init(), dict_validate(), dict_check_compat(), dict_merge(), dict_apply(). Wave assembly integrity checks: check_bind_ready(), harm_bind_waves(), harm_add_timepoint(), check_data_loss(), check_integrity(), flag_duplicate_cases(). Categorical multi-value helpers: assign_standard_labels(), detect_multival(), split_multival(). ID matching anonymization: check_id_audit(), normalize_id(), check_email(), anon_clean_email(), anon_hash().
